description: Translates natural language requests into bash commands via LLM and executes shell commands safely.
author: Charon Librarian

translate_and_execute_system_command.description: Translates NL directives to CLI syntax via LLM and executes shell tasks.

command.description: The shell command or natural language request to run.

model_name.description: Ollama model identifier to use for translation (defaults to llama3.1).

timeout.description: Execution timeout limit in seconds (defaults to 30.0).
